lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: lokan kee chaturaaee upamaa te baisa(n)tar jaar ||
lines.translation: I have burnt in the fire the clever devices and praises of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹਉ ਹਮ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਢਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: koee bhalaa kahau bhaavai buraa kahau ham tan deeo hai dhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Some speak good of me, and some speak ill of me, but I have surrendered my body to You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਆਵਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo aavat saran thaakur prabh tumaree tis raakhahu kirapaa dhaar ||
lines.translation: Whoever comes to Your Sanctuary, O God, Lord and Master, You save by Your Merciful Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saran tumaaree har jeeu raakhahu laaj muraar ||2||4||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord; O Lord, please, protect his honor! ||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai hau tis balihaaree ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh dekh jeevaa saadh gur darasan jis hiradai naam muraaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I live by continuously beholding the Blessed Vision of the Holy Guru's Darshan; within His Mind is the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੂਠਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum pavitr paavan purakh prabh suaamee ham kiu kar milah joothaaree ||
lines.translation: You are pure and immaculate, O God, Almighty Lord and Master; how can I, the impure one, meet You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai jeei hor mukh hor hot hai ham karamaheen kooRiaaree ||1||
lines.translation: I have one thing in my mind, and another thing on my lips; I am such a poor, unfortunate liar! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੁਸਟ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaree mudr naam har suaamee rid a(n)tar dusat dusataaree ||
lines.translation: I appear to chant the Lord's Name, but within my heart, I am the most wicked of the wicked.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran tumhaaree ||2||5||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, save me, O Lord and Master; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਨਕਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam binaa su(n)dar hai nakatee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the beautiful are just like the noseless ones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਜਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਕਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu besuaa ke ghar poot jamat hai tis naam pario hai dhrakatee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Like the son, born into the house of a prostitute, his name is cursed. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪ ਬੇਰਕਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai hiradai naahi har suaamee te bigaR roop berakatee ||
lines.translation: Those who do not have the Name of their Lord and Master within their hearts, are the most wretched, deformed lepers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu niguraa bahu baataa jaanai ohu har daragah hai bhrasatee ||1||
lines.translation: Like the person who has no Guru, they may know many things, but they are cursed in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਚਕਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau daiaal hoaa meraa suaamee tinaa saadh janaa pag chakatee ||
lines.translation: Those, unto whom my Lord Master becomes Merciful, long for the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਛੁਕਟੀ ॥੨॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧
lines.transliteration: naanak patit pavit mil sa(n)gat gur satigur paachhai chhukatee ||2||6|| chhakaa 1
lines.translation: O Nanak, the sinners become pure, joining the Company of the Holy; following the Guru, the True Guru, they are emancipated. ||2||6|| First Set of Six||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee gur charanee chit laaeeai ||
lines.translation: O mother, I focus my consciousness on the Guru's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh hoi kripaal kamal paragaase sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As God shows His Mercy, the lotus of my heart blossoms, and forever and ever, I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar eko baahar eko sabh mahi ek samaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is within, and the One Lord is outside; the One Lord is contained in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ghat avaghat raviaa sabh thaaee har pooran braham dikhaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Within the heart, beyond the heart, and in all places, God, the Perfect One, is seen to be permeating. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: usatat karahi sevak mun kete teraa a(n)t na katahoo paaeeai ||
lines.translation: So many of Your servants and silent sages sing Your Praises, but no one has found Your limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaate dukh bha(n)jan suaamee jan naanak sad bal jaaeeai ||2||1||
lines.translation: O Giver of peace, Destroyer of pain, Lord and Master - servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਸੋ ਹੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee honahaar so hoeeai ||
lines.translation: O mother, whatever is to be, shall be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹਾ ਖੋਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raach rahio rachanaa prabh apanee kahaa laabh kahaa khoeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God pervades His pervading creation; one gains, while another loses. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੋਗ ਕਬ ਹਸਨੋ ਕਬ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kah phoolahi aana(n)d bikhai sog kab hasano kab roeeai ||
lines.translation: Sometimes he blossoms in bliss, while at other times, he suffers in mourning. Sometimes he laughs, and sometimes he weeps.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kabahoo mail bhare abhimaanee kab saadhoo sa(n)g dhoeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Sometimes he is filled with the filth of ego, while at other times, he washes it off in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਲੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na metai prabh kaa keeaa doosar naahee aloeeai ||
lines.translation: No one can erase the actions of God; I cannot see any other like Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈਐ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree jih prasaad sukh soeeai ||2||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru; by His Grace, I sleep in peace. ||2||2||
